messages:
Nora: starting Cerulean Systems EAP thread — partner wants a compact bench window, strict telemetry (no raw prompts), and a governance sign-off for marketplace co-listing. who owns legal?

Eli: I can take NDA edits. Partner requires only aggregated metrics + salted hashes of request ids (sha256). They asked for 45-day retention. Will draft with KMS requirement.

Harper: Lab window booked 11/7-11/9 UTC. We'll provision 3x CS-XL nodes with partner firmware. Plan: micro-latency suite, mem-heavy seq=4096 pass, and 24h soak. Need exact run flags and artifact names.

Samir: Bench flags we recommend: `./bench --model=redwood-13b --seq=2048 --batch=1 --samples=300 --cache=on|off --warmup=50`. Capture `p50,p95,p99,gpu_util_pct,gpu_mem_mb,kv_hit_rate`. Save as `cerulean_eap_<date>_<phase>.json`.

Nora: Telemetry endpoint partner requested: `/metrics/cerulean-eap` exposing tokens_total, tokens_per_sec, p95_ms, gpu_util_pct, kv_hit_rate, req_hash_count. confirm no prompt fragments.

LegalBot: Draft clause: "Only aggregated performance metrics and cryptographic hashes (SHA-256) of request IDs may be exchanged; plaintext prompts/responses shall not be retained or shared. Test artifacts retained for 45 days and encrypted with KMS." Uploading draft now.

Eli: thanks. Partner also requested a short opt-in profiling capture (no plaintext) — allowed if scrubbed and aggregated. I'll add an opt-in profiling paragraph.

OpsBot: checklist uploaded: `drive.redwood.com/cerulean/eap-playbook-v1.md` (includes telemetry schema, bench matrix, and repro scripts).

Harper: note on cache: we should run three modes: cold (`--cache=off`), warm (`--cache=on`), and steady soak. Log `cache_mode` and `kv_hit_rate` fields.

Samir: sample sanitized output to include in artifacts: `{ "model": "redwood-13b", "phase": "warm", "p50_ms": 36.8, "p95_ms": 118.4, "gpu_util_pct": 80.2 }` — ensure runbook instructs to remove any prompt fragments.

Nora: marketplace ops: need 3-sentence co-list blurb, SVG+PNG logos, and a partner-approved quote by 11/15 to make our 11/22 soft co-list target. who owns copy?

Eli: I'll draft NDA and ping partner legal. Harper, can you provide the initial perf artifact by 11/8?

Harper: yes — dry-run on 11/7, full sweep on 11/8, artifacts uploaded same day. will include runbook and reproduce steps.

Samir: action recap: (1) Eli -> NDA + profiling opt-in paragraph; (2) Harper -> bench runs + artifacts; (3) Nora -> marketplace copy + solicit logos/quote; (4) OpsBot -> keep playbook updated. sync Tue 9am UTC to review artifacts.

Eli: uploaded NDA v0.2 to drive and pinged partner legal for signature.

OpsBot: uploaded bench checklist and telemetry schema to drive link above. will update with artifact links once posted.

Nora: thanks team — keeping this thread canonical for Cerulean EAP governance and co-list prep. :tada:
